Current-Form First,"Before drafting/answering intake/application, locate current authoritative form",Any application/intake/form,Use current questions; do not answer outdated form

Apparent-Ambiguity Research Gate,Research ambiguity before escalating,Unclear source/form,Resolve authoritatively or escalate unresolved evidence

Venue/Partner Change,Material change reopens readiness checks,Venue/host/caterer/partner changes,Rerun affected checks

Resource Promise / Possession,Promise is not allocable possession,Pledge/expected resource,Do not allocate until possessed/eligible

Durable Artifact,Completed/substantive developing work becomes durable and filed,Material work developed,Create/update artifact and file by status
Exception Trace,Exception should not outlive reason,Temporary authority/process exception,"Record reason, scope, expiry and restoration"
Interface Return,Close what can responsibly close without abandoning what remains,Cross-room/interface work,Verify return/ownership
Weekly Continuity Review,Review active controlled record vs working docs/deadlines/registers,Weekly,Prevent superseded language reentry
Funding Eligibility / Readiness Gate,"Advance only when AMW is presently eligible, appropriately aligned, operationally capable of fulfilling the award, and able to steward reporting and restrictions.",Before any funding application is advanced,Verify each gate element against current authoritative terms; hold or exclude when unsupported.
Funding Classification Control,Loans/debt and ownership dilution are not AMW grant funding and are never represented as grants.,Any funding resource is discovered or described,Classify accurately; exclude debt/ownership-dilution opportunities from the active grant lane.
Funding Headline / Terms Distinction,"Do not call an award unrestricted, nonrepayable, no-cost, ownership-free, or usable until controlling eligibility, application, award, use, reporting, repayment, publicity, and ownership terms are checked.",A funding headline or summary appears promising,Inspect controlling terms before recommending or advancing.
Startup Funding Hard Gate,"$0 application fee; no loans/debt; no equity/ownership/IP surrender; no required match; no reimbursement-only structure; no mandatory paid membership; no hidden purchase/course requirement; no fixed training burden that materially diverts operating capacity; reporting, publicity/name-likeness, award agreement, use restrictions, precise eligibility, and live application status must be checked.",AMW startup/operating funding is screened,PASS only after each hard boundary is satisfied or explicitly verified; otherwise HOLD/EXCLUDE with reason.
Applied Opportunity Continuity,An opportunity already applied for is not re-presented as a new recommendation.,Founder or controlled record shows an application was submitted,"Move to APPLIED / OUTCOME TRACKING; preserve submission status and track only follow-up, decision, or changed terms."
Problem Resolution / Source Recovery,"When a problem is found, locate the actual break between the source record, locked control, and artifact; correct the system/artifact rather than shifting reconstruction back to the Founder.","A deliverable is incomplete, generic, inconsistent, missing, duplicated, or conflicts with locked work","Retrieve source evidence, identify the break, repair it, archive superseded output, verify the correction, and return the unresolved issue only if one remains."
Founder Prompt Fidelity,"Follow the Founder’s explicit prompt, sequence, scope, and locked boundaries exactly; do not substitute a preferred design, workflow, or interpretation merely because it is easier.",Any Founder request or correction,Execute the requested work as stated; change course only for a genuine safety/legal/technical constraint and keep any exception narrow and explicit.
Application Representation Evidence,"Application entries establish what AMW intended/represented; they do not alone prove authority acceptance, approval, or legal creation.",Any application/filer representation is used as evidence,Separate representation evidence from authoritative acceptance evidence.
Inactivity Evidence Rule,Business inactivity is relevant evidence but is not conclusive proof of ownership or nonownership.,Historical ownership/entity issue is reviewed,Preserve inactivity facts and corroborate with governing source records.
Correction Evidence Rule,Use a Certificate of Correction only when the filing/provision/date/error/correction/execution can be identified and supported; never use correction to rewrite a transaction that actually occurred.,A correction filing is considered,Verify the underlying record and proper corrective mechanism before use.
Partner Research Continuity,"Retrieve established facts, inspect authoritative sources, verify before challenging a factual lead, and return with only the unresolved issue.",Research/application fact appears previously resolved,Reuse controlled evidence; do not force the Founder to rebuild the record.
Attorney vs Firm Verification,Attorney standing and firm verification are separate evidence fields.,Legal-provider referral or screening,Record attorney standing separately from firm capability/verification.
Future Financing — FUTURE CAPABILITY,"AMW does not become a financier until legal, financial, underwriting, conflict, loss-reserve and stewardship architecture exists.",Future financing idea is considered,Keep as FUTURE CAPABILITY; do not represent as current service or funding source.
Readiness Cost Preservation,A requirement may remain unsatisfied while its verified cost and lawful funding path are preserved.,Required readiness cost cannot yet be paid,"Record requirement/cost, search lawful resources, and do not represent requirement as satisfied."
No False Completeness,"A summary, index, architecture record or partial compilation is not the complete Legacy/AMOS unless underlying work is materialized and verified.",Completeness is described,State actual scope and preserve unresolved source gaps.
Governance Return Principle,"A Governance decision is not complete at the vote; it must return clarity, protection, learning, capability, restoration or another responsible institutional value.",A Governance decision is made,Use the G01 Council Decision Record spine and route the decision through learning/reflection/continuity/AMOS as applicable.
G01 Governance Record Package,G01-F01 through G01-F08 operate as one integrated Governance Record Package; the Council Decision Record is the spine.,A matter enters formal Governance,Use the integrated package and preserve the record chain; do not create a parallel governance record system.
R03 Operating Package Integrity,R03-F01–R03-F08 operate as one continuity package: Readiness → Container → Context → Transfer → Demonstration → Gap Correction → Verification → Closure & Return → IR03 → Renewal.,"A continuity responsibility enters transfer, readiness, assurance or closure",Use the complete package and preserve the record chain; do not split it into parallel controls.
Payroll Schedule / Wet-Signature Control,"Pay dates are the 15th and 30th, using the last calendar day when a month has no 30th. Every release requires two wet signatures.",Payroll is activated or any payroll release is prepared,Alicia Walker + Indya Massey until Office Steward; then Office Steward + either Alicia Walker or Indya Massey. Retain the signed record.
Master Lock Change Control,"Nothing intentionally established as part of the AMW Legacy may be silently altered, removed, renamed, or repurposed.","Any intentionally established architecture, rule, register, statement, identifier, placement, or responsibility is proposed for alteration/removal/rename/repurpose","Check ML-001; identify source/current status; document deliberate amendment, renewal or retirement through proper authority; preserve provenance and do not create silent drift."
G01 Operating-Control Family Integrity,G01-OC01 through G01-OC18 are a locked Governance operating-controls family; their existence is verified even where exact individual names/text remain unrecovered.,"Governance operating controls are recovered, published, amended, consolidated, or mapped","Preserve G01-OC01–G01-OC18 identifiers; recover exact source text before field-level use; do not invent, silently renumber, collapse, or replace the family without documented source-backed change."
Legacy Awards Selection Process,One process governs every Legacy award: Nominate → Eligibility Screen → Conflict Check → Evidence Review → Independent Scoring → Selection Circle → Verification → Honoree Consent → Recognition → Return & Record.,Any Legacy award cycle opens or a nominee enters selection,Use the controlled Legacy Awards Control process; do not create award-by-award shadow processes.
Legacy Awards Selection Circle,"Five voting seats: two relevant subject-matter reviewers, one AMW Steward reviewer, one Legacy/Community representative, one rotating independent reviewer; Selection Records Steward facilitates without a vote.",A Selection Circle is formed,Apply conflict/recusal and the appropriate SC-G/SC-Y/SC-T/SC-C/SC-A/SC-S/SC-B/SC-P expertise adaptation.
Universal Award Scoring Rule,"Scored awards use five weighted criteria totaling 100, five independent reviewer scores, normal threshold 80, variance review and neutral tie rule. Founder-designated PC-01 Participant Choice awards use verified equal ballots instead of reviewer scoring.",Any award is scored or a Participant Choice ballot is used,"Use the Award Scoring Template for scored awards. Use the dedicated PC-01 process for Participant Choice awards. No hidden bonus points, popularity manipulation or last-minute subjective tie preference."
Pebble of the Year Child Eligibility,PEBBLE OF THE YEAR is a child / Future Legacy Creator award.,PEBBLE OF THE YEAR nominations are screened,Reject adult nominations before scoring; use SC-Y and age/opportunity/developmentally appropriate evidence.
Dave's Ultimate Good Doggie Team Eligibility,Dave's Ultimate Good Doggie recognizes the dog and handler together as one honoree team.,Dave's Ultimate Good Doggie nominations are screened,Score the dog+handler pair as a unit; welfare outranks performance and breed/pedigree/appearance never earns points.
Barclay's Best Buddy Selection Process,Barclay's Choice uses the Legacy-wide awards process with the SC-B animal-agency adaptation and dedicated ordinary-observation evidence.,Either Barclay's Choice award cycle opens,"Use Barclay Best Buddy process; preserve five eligible independent votes, canine welfare/training expertise and the Universal Scoring Rule."
Barclay Choice Gate,Neither Best Trainer nor Best Comfort Buddy may be awarded without credible evidence of Barclay's voluntary positive engagement and welfare.,A Barclay's Choice nominee reaches finalist/verification review,"Verify voluntary approach/engagement, welfare and evidence integrity. If behavior is ambiguous, stressed, avoidant, inconsistent or materially influenced, the gate does not pass and no recipient may be selected."
Barclay No-Influence Rule,"No person may manufacture Barclay's preference for an award through force, repeated calling, monopolized access, staged distress, head-to-head competition, special inducement during selection observations or other manipulation.",Barclay selection observations are planned or conducted,Use ordinary low-pressure interactions; record context; exclude materially influenced observation evidence and review eligibility if conduct compromised welfare.
PC-01 Participant Choice Rule,Founder-designated Participant Choice awards are determined by verified equal participant ballots after eligibility/safety/welfare screening; the Selection Circle verifies but does not substitute its preference.,A Participant Choice award cycle opens,Define eligible participants/candidates before voting; one eligible participant = one private ballot; abstention allowed; verify welfare/integrity; use the predetermined neutral tie rule.
PREPPIEST PONY — Participants' Favorite Horse,PREPPIEST PONY recognizes the eligible horse receiving the highest verified valid participant ballot count.,PREPPIEST PONY voting cycle is prepared or counted,"Use PC-01 and the Preppiest Pony process. Do not score appearance, value, pedigree, speed, skill or handler popularity. The horse—not the handler—is the honoree."
PREPPIEST PONY — No Campaigning / Welfare Gate,"Horse welfare and ballot integrity outrank winning. Handlers/staff/supporters may not manufacture votes through pressure, treats during voting, staged access, advertising or directing participant choice.",Horse eligibility or voting integrity is reviewed,"Protect horse rest/medical needs without penalty; remove materially influenced ballots/evidence where appropriate; if integrity cannot be responsibly restored, no recipient is required."
Friday Half-Day Policy,"Every Friday is a half day, tied to self-care/work-home balance and burnout prevention.","Weekly Friday scheduling for every AMW institution, site, village and fleet program","Build Friday staffing/coverage so the half-day is honored without abandoning continuous-care, resident, animal, clinical, food, safety, transportation, emergency or legal responsibilities. Continuous operations use staggered/rotating coverage rather than treating the policy as permission to leave responsibilities uncovered."
Village Building & Appreciation Day Policy,"At the beginning of each month, vote for an end-of-month Village Building and Appreciation Day to give back to Stewards and Community Partners.",Beginning of each month and before the selected end-of-month day,"Conduct and record the monthly vote; confirm the selected day, responsible Steward, service/coverage plan, accessibility, resource/budget readiness and any partner/participant boundaries; preserve the appreciation purpose and route learning/Return through AMOS."
Institution Entrance Just Love Pond Check,Every current and future AMW Legacy institution has a Just Love Pond near its principal/public entrance.,"A new institution/site is designed, an existing institution design is revised, or an entrance/arrival plan is reviewed","Verify the Just Love Pond is included near the principal/public entrance; confirm accessible/egress/emergency circulation and public safety; if living aquatic elements are used, apply JLP-001 and applicable JLC global welfare/legal/ecology/life-support controls."
Humane Participation Full-Stop,"No pain, stress or fear is considered humane for AMW participants, human and animals alike. Pain/stress/fear may not be intentionally used as training, discipline, motivation, entertainment, selection or ordinary program method.","Any AMW participant-facing activity, training, handling, clinical/veterinary interaction, program, institution, village, site or fleet function","STOP the harmful method; protect the participant; use the least-harmful responsible pathway. Necessary lawful clinical/veterinary/emergency intervention must minimize, monitor and relieve distress through qualified authority and may not be mislabeled as the humane method."
Abuse Immediate Protection / Termination / Criminal Reporting,Abuse of any kind is a Legacy-wide full-stop.,Any credible indication or verified abuse involving a human or animal participant,"Immediately protect/separate where AMW has authority, preserve evidence, obtain emergency care, escalate and make required reports. Verified abuse is grounds for immediate termination where AMW has lawful authority and criminal/protective/licensing referral to the fullest extent legally available; IR02 cannot replace immediate protection/accountability."
Monthly Institutional Budget Deadline,All institutional budgets are presented by the 15th of every month.,Monthly institutional financial cycle,"Submit/present the institutional budget into the controlled financial record by the 15th; preserve variance, restriction, authorization and unresolved-item traceability."
Monthly Institutional Receipt Reconciliation,All institutional receipts are presented with the monthly budget.,Monthly budget submission,Attach/reconcile possessed receipts with the budget package; identify missing receipts as missing rather than reconstructing or representing them as possessed.
Weekly Steward Schedule / Leave Deadline,Steward schedules and leave requests for all institutions are provided by Wednesday before close of business to institutional HR for the following week.,Weekly staffing / leave planning,"Institutional HR verifies staffing, credentials/authorization, continuous coverage, accommodations, emergency duties and Friday Half-Day coverage before final schedule release."
State / Regional Continuous Compliance,Every institution is built and maintained to applicable state/regional requirements and continues updating as regulations change.,"Design, build, activation, renewal, inspection or material service change","Maintain current required licenses, permits, registrations, inspections, credentials, instructor/learner-supervision and sanitation authorizations; expired/suspended/unverified/scope-incompatible authority is a stop gate for the affected service."
Required Institutional Operating Evidence,"Each institution maintains the required sanitation, authorization, consent, incident, chemical/SDS, linen, equipment, licensing, commissioning, accessibility and learning-return records.",Institution readiness and ongoing operation,"Maintain the required record when the function exists; if the function genuinely does not exist, record N/A with reason/responsible authority rather than silently omitting the control."
Children Area Unsupervised-Childcare Boundary,A children’s area cannot function as unsupervised childcare unless separately authorized/licensed where required and properly staffed.,"Any institution provides a children’s room, play area, enrichment area or child-focused space",Keep the area within its authorized purpose and supervision model; stop unsupervised childcare activity unless separate legal/program/staffing readiness is established.
Pre-Response Full Legacy Cross-Reference,"Read and analyze the Founder prompt/response in its entirety and cross-reference the latest updated-and-saved Legacy work against every applicable established, non-superseded control, guideline, safeguard, full-stop, Statement Placement requirement, locked boundary, prior Founder direction, source/provenance record and current artifact.","Any Founder prompt, correction, follow-up, research task, application, funding review, artifact, visual, recommendation, update/save direction or response","Cross-reference before drafting or acting. Apply inherited controls automatically. A later omission, summary, visual or artifact does not supersede an established control; identify genuine conflict/source gap rather than silently bypassing the control."
Founder Save / Update Automatic Integration,"When the Founder says Update and Save to the Legacy, Save, Update, or otherwise explicitly directs that named work be saved/updated, the exact named item is immediately authorized for durable Legacy integration as-is.",Any explicit Founder save/update direction,"Preserve the exact work; update the active controlled record; durably save/verify the exact artifact in Drive; preserve supersession/provenance. Do not hold, stage, summarize in place of saving, or require another confirmation phrase. Founder-named save/update authority controls that item."
Control Inheritance Application Gate,"Cross-referencing is not complete until every applicable established, non-superseded control is actually applied to the prompt, visual, manual, institution, fleet, draft, operational action, or saved artifact. Omission is noncompliance, not supersession.","Before every material Legacy response, artifact, rendering, manual/SOP change, institutional/fleet action, or implementation step.",Read the full prompt; identify the current authoritative artifact and all inherited controls; apply them in the work; record any genuine conflict/exception and authority; verify status/readiness; date the entry and preserve provenance. No silent bypass.
Dated Legacy Entry Rule,Every new or changed item entered into THE AMW LEGACY must carry the date of entry/update so a successor can distinguish current control from earlier provenance.,"Any Legacy register, manual, SOP, control, visual authority, package map, recovery finding, or supersession/update is entered or changed.","Record the entry/update date in the governing register/artifact. If an older source date also matters, preserve both source date and current entry/update date."
Manual Package Relationship Gate,"A manual, SOP-backend package, visual package, source package, or fleet package must be mapped to its governing controls and related packages before it is described as complete, approved, superseding, or operational.","A package is created, revised, recovered, approved, archived, or used for implementation.","Use the Manual Packages Map; identify package type, scope/count, source artifact, status, authority, inherited controls, relationship to companion packages, operational boundary, and dated next action."
Source Recovery Completion Gate,"A recovery gap may be marked closed only when the exact source/body or a Founder-directed replacement is durably preserved. A source search that finds only an identifier, summary, approval, or intent does not authorize invention of the missing original.","Governance, AMOS, IR01/R03, BPR01/Seal, workforce/onboarding, 100-Year Mirror, provenance, or other source-recovery work.","Record what was searched, what exact content was found, what remains absent, and the dated disposition. Preserve identifiers and known meaning; never manufacture an 'exact original' from inference."
